body.name: Rank-summary graph confidence set
body.construction: Let \(K_B=8p^2\kappa^{-2}\), \(L=224(M/m)p^4\kappa^{-4}\), and \(T=(L+1)r\). If \(r\ge\kappa/(2p)\), \(b\le2K_Br\), or \(\lambda_{\min}(\widehat R_0)<\kappa/2\), set \(\widehat{\mathcal G}_{\alpha}=\mathfrak G_V\). Otherwise set \(\widehat{\mathcal G}_{\alpha}=\{\operatorname{supp}_{K_Br}(B^{\pi}(\widehat R_0)):Q_{\pi}(\widehat R,d)\le T,\ \pi\in\mathfrak S_V\}\), where \(\operatorname{supp}_{t}(C)=\{i\to j:|C_{ji}|>t\}\).
